text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I visited the beach hut that Mejiro Bright 
praised as "delicious"... but a woman who 
seemed to be the manager was bustling 
around all on her own amidst the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Bright-chan, was it?! I'm so sorry, 
all the part-timers took the day off 
today! It might be quite a while before a 
table opens up!"
choice_data_list:
Running the beach house solo during peak 
season is tough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Trainer-sama~. I would love to 
help the store manager out~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Is our order coming anytime 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, I'll be right there~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, waiter! Sorry! The kid spilled 
their juice! Could you bring something to 
wipe the table with, please?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a mess~. I'll bring a hand 
towel right away~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer C
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! We're ready for the check over 
here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please hold on a moment~. I'll be 
taking your orders one by one~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text:
That clerk is really taking their sweet 
time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a huge gap between the density of 
customer orders and Mejiro Bright's 
leisurely pace. I'd love to help her out, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, keep washing those dishes 
quickly! Looks like we're gonna run out 
soon!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Helping out in the kitchen has turned into 
absolute chaos for me too. At this point, 
all I can do is rely on Mejiro Bright's 
lone struggle.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer D
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. Three ciders and one yakisoba. 
And then—have you guys decided what you 
want to eat?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! I haven't decided yet!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer D
text_block_list.text:
Geez, she's been staring at the menu 
forever... Why hasn't she decided yet?!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer E
text_block_list.text:
"It's all the same, right? How about 
everyone just gets the same order?"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Dad, you always make decisions 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Every single dish was sooo very 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Really~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So, if you pick what you want to eat 
most right now, it's sure to become a 
wonderful memory~

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
First place...!! Um, um... Then I'll take 
this one!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer D
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, miss. I guess the traffic 
and crowds made me irritated.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer E
text_block_list.text:
I need to take it a bit easier. After all, 
this child has been looking forward to 
this for so long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is true~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The kitchen was as stiflingly hot as ever, 
but the atmosphere inside the restaurant 
seemed to have shifted slightly.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Manager
text_block_list.text:
...All the tables are still full, but 
somehow the chatter from the customers 
feels a lot nicer now.
choice_data_list:
(...I'll check on her when I have a free 
moment.)

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer F
text_block_list.text:
I dunno, like, talking to the clerk 
kinda... softens up your mood, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer G
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, let's stop stressing out and 
just chill while we wait! I can't wait for 
the food~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu~. I believe that would be lovely~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer H
text_block_list.text:
It's so hooot... Standing in line in this 
heat is seriously rough—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To all the guests waiting in line, we also 
have cold water available for you~. Please 
bear with us just a little longer~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer H
text_block_list.text: —Maybe it's... not that exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Papa and Mama stopped being mad, and 
dinner was super-duper yummy! Thanks, Big 
Sis!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am glad to hear that. Thank you 
very much~.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer F
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, check please~! Man, we sure 
drank a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you so much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once things in the kitchen had calmed down 
a bit, I stepped out with the manager to 
check on things—
choice_data_list:
Before anyone realized it, the whole shop 
was filled with a warm atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's a far cry from the usual 
rowdiness, but in its own way, maybe it 
really grabs the customers' hearts.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Manager
text_block_list.text:
Man, you two were a huge help! Thanks a 
bunch! I'd hire you every single day if I 
could, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her unique style of customer service bore 
fruit, resulting in both great sales and a 
fantastic reputation.
choice_data_list:
Maybe you're surprisingly suited for this 
kind of business?

Could you teach me the secret to customer 
service...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~? Is being mellow something to be 
afraid of~?
choice_data_list: No, no, that's not what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand, but if the 
guests are satisfied, then I'm happy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"All's well that ends well. It's best not 
to overthink things."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well, if there's ever a chance in 
the future, it might be nice to open some 
kind of shop~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"A doll workshop might be lovely too~. 
When that time comes, please join me, 
Trainer-sama. Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sensing potential hidden business acumen, 
they returned once more to their days of 
training."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would it be... to make sure everyone has a 
wonderful, fun time~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So... don't panic, don't rush, and just 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to stay by the customers' side 
with a smile takes real toughness. It's 
the fruit of daily dedication.
